summary: Iteration 22 (conferencing enhancements): Backend rtc/config STUN default + TURN injection + admin-gate verified via pytest (5/5). Frontend dashboard/admin top call bars, in-call chat/hand/participants panels, channel Meet auto-post, and admin TURN editor all verified in browser.

minor.issue: Sending empty credential preserves the previous stored credential (backend keeps prev.credential when body.credential is falsy). Cleanup effectively works because _build_ice only adds TURN when urls is non-empty, but admin cannot explicitly clear an existing credential without a manual sentinel. After UI cleanup, GET /api/admin/rtc-config still returns has_credential: true even though calls fall back to STUN.

integration_issues.issue: The posted message renders the join URL as plain text, not as a clickable <a> tag. Message text/content is correct and includes the full /call/<room> URL, but users must copy-paste it or click the message. Consider auto-linking URLs in message bodies.

action_items: (Minor) Auto-linkify URLs in chat messages so the /call/<room> link in the auto-posted meeting invite is clickable.
(Minor) In PUT /api/admin/rtc-config, allow an explicit way to clear the stored TURN credential (e.g. treat empty string as clear, or accept credential: null).
critical_code_review_comments: meetings.py PUT rtc-config: `credential: cred if cred else prev.get('credential','')` prevents explicit credential clearing — sentinel needed.
Messages.jsx startChannelMeeting: message body contains a full URL but is rendered as plain text; consider a linkify pass or Markdown link.
Call.jsx panels/chat/hand controls all wired with data-testid — good testability. Chat input clears after send; participant count badge visible on people-btn ('1' for solo).

Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_rtc_config.py covers STUN default, TURN injection, admin gating, credential masking. rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. Two minor observations documented above.
